data.title: US Dollar Faces Bearish Outlook While Euro Takes Center Stage
data.description: ING anticipates a bullish trend for EUR/USD, forecasting challenges for the US dollar influenced by economic data and geopolitical events.

data.title: Euro bounces as German inflation steadies, U.S. yield gap widens
data.description: The euro posted a 1% gain over two sessions, boosted by stable German inflation and expectations for a slightly stronger EU GDP print. However, rising U.S. yields have widened the 10-year rate differential, limiting long-term upside for the euro. Bob Iaccino discusses the recent strength in Euro…
